newsitem.title: USA: Gingrich sees US balanced budget amendment success.
newsitem.headline: Gingrich sees US balanced budget amendment success.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich predicted Wednesday that Congress would pass a balanced budget amendment to the Constitution.
He also said he was opposed to any "legislative fix" on the Consumer Price Index.

Gingrich, speaking to reporters following a news conference by advocates of the constitutional amendment, said: "I think there is a very high likelihood it will pass because the country wants it very, very badly."
Asked about discussions of changes in the calculation of the Consumer Price Index that could affect Social Security payments, Gingrich said: "I am opposed to any legislative fix on the CPI."

Responding to charges by some Democrats that the balanced budget amendment could harm Social Security, Gingrich said its advocates had to make clear to people that "we will not touch Social Security."
